language.automatic.description: The first choice in the language list. {language} is the language it picks now, by that language's own name (Deutsch, Polski).

language.forced.defaultMessage: Combwork was started in {language} (--lang): this setting applies from its next start.
language.forced.description: Under the language list when a start option chose the language. {language} is its code (pl, en-XA). --lang is a start option: keep it as it is.

language.restart.defaultMessage: Combwork's own text has changed language. Chromium's parts (the PDF viewer, date pickers) follow when Combwork next starts.
language.restart.description: Under the language list after the language was changed, until Combwork restarts. Chromium is the browser engine Combwork is built on: keep the name.

language.setting.desc.defaultMessage: The language Combwork shows. Automatic follows Windows' display languages.

language.setting.tip.defaultMessage: Languages marked as translated by AI were drafted by agents, and improvements are welcome. Combwork speaks to agents and the Assistant in English whatever this says; they can still answer you in your language. Combwork started with --lang uses that language until it next starts.
language.setting.tip.description: The Language setting's info tip. --lang is a start option: keep it as it is.

language.setting.title.description: The setting's title in Settings → General. In any language but English, Combwork adds "(Language)" after it, so someone who can't read the language can find the way back.
